login.title: Sign in
login.greeting: Welcome back. Sign in to continue with your analyses.
login.noAccount: No account yet? Ask your administrator for access.

passwordChange.title: Change your password
passwordChange.reason: This account still uses its initial password. Choose a new one to continue.
passwordChange.hint: At least 12 characters. A long phrase beats a strange symbol.

home.subtitle: Your analyses in progress will show up here.
home.nextStepBody: Register a system and upload its code to get the first report.

errors.internal: Something failed on our side. Try again in a moment.
errors.validation: Check the data: something is missing or has an unexpected format.
errors.network: We could not reach the server. Check your connection.

auth.accountLocked: Too many failed attempts. Wait a few minutes before retrying.
auth.accountDisabled: This account is disabled. Talk to your administrator.
auth.invalidToken: Your session is not valid. Sign in again.
auth.sessionRevoked: We closed your session for safety. Sign in again.
auth.passwordChangeRequired: You must change your password before continuing.
auth.weakPassword: That password is too short. Use at least 12 characters.
auth.forbidden: Your role is not allowed to do this.
auth.invalidUsername: The username must be initial + lastname, lowercase, with no dots.

ingest.failed: The submitted code could not be processed.
ingest.zipSlip: The ZIP file contains forbidden paths.
ingest.zipTooLarge: The ZIP file exceeds the maximum allowed size.
ingest.tooManyEntries: The ZIP file has too many entries.
ingest.zipBomb: The ZIP file has a suspicious compression ratio.
ingest.invalidArchive: The file is not a valid ZIP.
ingest.forbiddenHost: The repository address points to a forbidden network.
ingest.invalidUrl: The repository address is not valid (HTTPS only).
ingest.repoUnreachable: The repository could not be reached.

analysis.notReady: The analysis has not finished yet.
analysis.sbomInvalid: The generated component inventory is not valid.
analysis.normalization: A tool's output could not be interpreted.
analysis.noToolRan: No analysis tool could run. Check the installation.

report.renderFailed: The report could not be generated.
report.versionNotFound: That report version does not exist.
report.versionNotCurrent: Only the current version can be signed. Reload the page.
report.unknownSection: That report section cannot be edited.
report.sectionTooLong: The section text is too long.

workflow.failed: The workflow action could not be completed.
workflow.justificationRequired: Write a reason of at least 10 characters: it goes to the audit log.
workflow.stageFinal: The report is the last stage: there is nowhere to advance.
workflow.stageLocked: That stage is already closed: its content cannot change.
workflow.testPlanNotFound: There is no test plan yet.
workflow.testPlanEmpty: Include at least one function in the plan.
workflow.testPlanFunctionUnknown: One of the chosen functions is not in the analysis metrics. Reload the page.

gate.closed: The current stage does not meet its condition to close yet.
gate.analysisNotDone: The analysis has not finished yet.
gate.triagePending: Findings are still pending review: each one needs a verdict.
gate.testPlanMissing: The test plan is missing: at least one function, the coverage strictness and your rationale.
gate.notBuilt: This stage cannot be closed yet in this version of the platform.
gate.casesNotApproved: Some functions of the plan still lack approved cases.
gate.testsNotWritten: Some cases are still unwritten. Write something of your own in each before moving to verification.
gate.notVerified: Some functions have never been verified. Run the verification before moving to the report.
gate.verificationFailed: Some functions do not pass verification. Fix the tests or redesign their cases.

workflow.stageNotReached: That stage has not started yet: the previous ones close first.
workflow.caseItemUnknown: A case points at a brief item that no longer exists. Reload the page.
workflow.casesInvalid: Each case needs between 3 and 500 characters, and 200 cases is the maximum.
workflow.briefNotCovered: Some points of the brief are still covered by no case.
workflow.casesTooFew: Fewer cases than paths: the brief asks for at least one per path.
workflow.testPlanFunctionUnbriefable: {{function}} ({{path}}, line {{line}}) cannot be read for the brief (unsupported language, file too large, syntax error or a different name): leave it out of the plan.
workflow.testPlanFunctionTooComplex: {{function}} ({{path}}, line {{line}}) has more paths than one function's design can hold: leave it out of the plan and ask for it to be split.
workflow.designNotApproved: That function's cases are not approved yet, so there is no file to prepare.
workflow.testsUnparsable: The test file has a syntax error and cannot be read.
workflow.testsTooLarge: The test file is too large.
workflow.mutantUnknown: That mutant is not among the survivors of the function's latest run.

ast.failed: That function's code could not be analyzed.
ast.unsupportedLanguage: That file is not in a language the platform analyzes (JS/TS and Python in this version).
ast.sourceTooLarge: The file is too large to draw.
ast.functionNotFound: We could not find that function in the code.
ast.parseFailed: The function has syntax errors; fix them in the code before designing.
ast.tooDeep: The function is nested beyond the limit; simplify it before designing.
ast.functionNotInPlan: That function is not in the test plan.

sandbox.failed: The run inside the isolated container could not complete.
sandbox.unavailable: The isolated environment is not available on this server.
sandbox.timeout: The run exceeded its time limit and the container was stopped.
sandbox.resultsUnreadable: The run's results could not be read.

inventory.failed: The inventory action could not be completed.
inventory.dumpTooLarge: The vulnerability-database file exceeds the maximum size.
inventory.dumpInvalid: The file is not a valid OSV or NVD dump.
inventory.dumpKindUnknown: Unrecognised format: OSV's all.zip or NVD's nvdcve-2.0-<year>.json(.gz) are accepted.
inventory.syncDisabled: Synchronisation is disabled on this deployment: import the file by hand.
inventory.sbomMissing: This analysis has no SBOM: the generator could not read its dependencies.
inventory.downloadFailed: The vulnerability database could not be downloaded.
inventory.enqueueFailed: The job could not be scheduled: the queue is not responding. Try again in a moment.

analysis.failedBody: The analysis could not finish. Code:

projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: Every system the factory audits, with its latest analysis.
projects.nextStepBody: Register the system you are going to analyze: name, technology and owner.
projects.nextStepBodyDeveloper: An analyst registers the systems. Here you will see the projects where you have to write tests.

form.intro: These details go straight into the report's "System details" table.
form.name: Project name
form.hint: You will upload the code next.

nextStep.codeBody: Upload a ZIP or paste the repository's HTTPS address. The analysis runs on its own and tells you when it is done.
nextStep.triageBody: Confirm or discard every finding with a written reason. When you finish, the test plan unlocks.
nextStep.planBody: The developer picks which functions to test and how strictly. The findings review is closed.
nextStep.laterBody: Follow the process from the Workflow tab. Every stage closes with a written reason.

ingest.intro: The code is analyzed in an isolated environment with no internet access. Nothing from the system is executed.
ingest.privacy: Everything stays on this server: no tool queries external services.

explain.title: What are we going to review?
explain.security: patterns that allow injections, XSS, exposed secrets.
explain.deps: libraries with known vulnerabilities, according to the local database.
explain.secrets: passwords, keys and tokens left in the code or its history.
explain.health: complexity per function, lines per language, commented-out code.

analyses.title: Analyses
analyses.empty: No version has been analyzed yet.

findings.title: Findings and review
findings.confirm: It's real — include in the report
findings.justificationLabel: Why? Your reason goes to the audit log
findings.justificationPlaceholder: E.g.: the file is a sample that is never deployed; the secret was already rotated.
findings.justificationHint: At least {{min}} characters. Required to confirm and to discard.

nextStep.pendingBody: When you finish, the next step unlocks: planning the tests.
nextStep.doneBody: Every finding has a verdict. Move on to the test plan, or edit and sign the report.
nextStep.advance: Move on to the test plan

report.title: Report
report.subtitle: Version {{number}} · institutional template
report.editedHint: This section has its own text; the rest comes from the template.
report.versionLine: Version {{number}} · edited by {{user}} · full history in the audit log.
report.versionLineBaseline: Version 1 · generated automatically. Saving a change creates version 2.

nextStep.triageBody: The report can already be read and exported, but sign it once the review is complete.
nextStep.readyTitle: Report ready to edit and sign
nextStep.readyBody: Review each section, fix what is needed and sign the final version. Signing locks it.
nextStep.signedBody: This version cannot change. Editing a section opens the next version.

edit.textHint: Plain text. Separate paragraphs with a blank line.
edit.changeLabel: What did you change? It goes to the version control table
edit.changePlaceholder: E.g.: the analysis scope was adjusted as agreed.

sign.label: Sign this version — why do you approve it?
sign.placeholder: E.g.: reviewed in full with the development team.
sign.hint: Signing locks the version. Later changes open a new one.
sign.locked: The current version is signed and locked.

versions.title: Version control
versions.none: No saved versions yet: the report exports as generated.

advance.reasonLabel: Why are you closing this stage? It goes to the audit log
advance.reasonPlaceholder: E.g.: every finding has a verdict and the team reviewed the discarded ones.

plan.title: What are we going to test?
plan.subtitle: Functions ranked by risk: how complex each one is and whether it has security findings. Pick the ones that enter the plan.
plan.noFunctions: The analysis measured no functions (Lizard did not run or the code has no recognizable functions).

reason.complexWithFindings: Very complex ({{ccn}} possible paths) and with {{count}} security finding(s) in its file — an urgent candidate.
reason.complex: Very complex ({{ccn}} possible paths), no findings.
reason.mediumWithFindings: Medium complexity ({{ccn}} paths) and {{count}} security finding(s) in its file.
reason.simpleWithFindings: Simple ({{ccn}} paths), but with {{count}} security finding(s) in its file.
reason.simple: Simple ({{ccn}} paths), no findings. It can wait.

criterion.title: How strict will the coverage be?
criterion.statementsHint: With "Statements" every line runs at least once. It is the minimum.
criterion.decisionsHint: With "Decisions" every branch of the code is tested true and false. It is the plan's standard.
criterion.pathsHint: With "Paths" every independent path is walked. The strictest; use it on critical functions.

plan.rationaleLabel: Why this plan? In your own words
plan.rationalePlaceholder: E.g.: we start with validation because it concentrates the findings and every form uses it.
plan.rationaleHint: At least {{min}} characters. Your rationale goes into the report.
plan.rationaleInReport: Your rationale goes into the report.
plan.saveAndDesign: Save plan and design the cases →

nextStep.notYetBody: The findings review closes first. You can look at the ranking meanwhile.
nextStep.emptyTitle: Pick the functions that enter the plan
nextStep.developerBody: Include the functions, choose the strictness and explain why. Saving and moving on opens the case design.
nextStep.readerBody: The developer builds the plan. Here you can see what they chose and why.
nextStep.lockedBody: The plan stage is closed: the case design works on this plan and it cannot change.

plan.incomplete: Include at least one function and write your rationale ({{min}} characters or more).

design.title: Case design
design.subtitle: Every function of the plan, drawn from its code. Design your cases looking at the diagram and the brief.

diagram.loading: Drawing the diagram from the code…
diagram.legend: Diamonds: decisions and loops · red border: error or exception · dashed arrow: back to the loop.

mermaid.title: Diagram (Mermaid) · editable
mermaid.editedBy: Text edited by {{user}}. The drawing above is still the code's.
mermaid.note: Arrange the diagram as you like; the brief is computed from the code, not from the diagram.

cases.title: Your cases, in your words
cases.intro: Describe what you will test and what you expect to happen. The code comes later.
cases.placeholder: What goes in, what you do and what you expect to happen
cases.reopened: You changed the cases: they need approving again.
cases.tooFew_one: {{count}} more case is needed to reach the brief's minimum.
cases.tooFew_other: {{count}} more cases are needed to reach the brief's minimum.
cases.complete: Every point of the brief is covered.
cases.unsaved: Save the cases before approving them.
cases.empty: No cases for this function yet.
cases.readOnly: The developer writes the cases; they are shown here as the developer left them.
cases.approveHint_one: On approval, the platform prepares the test file with this case already named.
cases.approveHint_other: On approval, the platform prepares the test files with these {{count}} cases already named.

nextStep.notYetBody: The test plan closes first. You can look at the diagrams meanwhile.
nextStep.designBody: For each function: look at the diagram, read the brief and write your cases. Once all are approved, you move on to writing the tests.
nextStep.doneBody: The cases of every function were approved as shown here.

brief.title: The brief asks you for
brief.loading: Computing the brief from the code…
brief.minCasesWithMalicious: At least {{count}} cases: one per path and one per security finding.

error.early_return: Error path (line {{line}}): {{text}} — returns before the end.

brief.malicious: One case with malicious input: there is a finding at line {{line}} ({{text}}).
brief.none: No branches or boundaries: the brief asks for one happy-path case.

advance.label: Move on to writing the tests →
advance.blocked_one: Approve the cases of the plan's one function ({{approved}} of {{count}}).
advance.blocked_other: Approve the cases of every function in the plan ({{approved}} of {{count}}).

tests.title: Write the tests
tests.subtitle: The platform hands you the file with your cases already named. You write the assertions: writing the test is the learning.
tests.scaffoldNote: File {{filename}}, for {{runner}}. It brings the name, the imports and one case per approved case. No assertion: the machine does not write that.
tests.caseWritten: You already wrote something in this case.
tests.yourFileNote: Stored as text and never run here: the tests execute in the next stage, inside the isolated container.
tests.parseError: The file cannot be read: it has a syntax error. Fix it and save again; until then no case counts as written.
tests.readOnly: Only the developer writes the tests, and only during this stage.

nextStep.notYetTitle: Writing tests is not due yet
nextStep.notYetBody: The cases of every function have to be approved in the design first.
nextStep.doneBody: The stage is closed: now they run and how much they really cover is measured.
nextStep.writeBody: Write at least one line of your own in every case. Whether it proves anything is measured by the next stage, not by this one.
nextStep.noPlanBody: The test plan is empty, so there are no cases to write.

advance.label: Go to run and measure →
advance.blocked_one: One case still to write: you have {{written}}.

verify.title: Verification
verify.subtitle: Your tests run inside an isolated container with no network. Then we break the code on purpose: a good test must fail.
verify.noRuns: No verification has been run yet.
verify.actionsNote: Running takes a while: every function runs in its own container, with coverage and the mutation run.
verify.started: Verification queued. Come back to this screen in a moment.
verify.reopenNote: Reopen the functions that failed so you can redesign their cases. The stage does not move back: you stay in Verification.
verify.reasonLabel: Why you are going back to the design
verify.reopen: Reopen the design of the failing ones
verify.reopened: Done: those functions are editable again.
verify.readOnly: Only the developer runs the verification, and only during this stage.

reason.tests_failed: A test failed when it ran.
reason.assertion_free: Some cases run the code but check nothing. A test with no assertion always passes.
reason.coverage_short: Coverage falls short of the criterion you chose in the plan.
reason.brief_uncovered: Some brief items have a line that never ran, or a branch left half taken.
reason.mutant_survived: We broke the code on purpose and your tests stayed green. That mutant is what is left to prove.
reason.sandbox_error: The run could not be carried out. Check the detail and try again.

nextStep.notYetBody: The tests of every case have to be written first.
nextStep.neverRunBody: Run the tests to measure how much they really cover and whether they detect errors.
nextStep.resultBody: Every function has to pass in full: tests green, coverage at the criterion, every brief item executed and no mutant alive.

advance.label: Go to the report →
advance.blocked: Some functions still do not pass verification.

verify.equivalentNote: An equivalent mutant is one no test can detect because the code still does the same thing (changing a text that is only written to the log, for example). Write why; it is recorded in the audit log and the report, and discounted on the next run.
verify.equivalentMarked: Marked. Run and measure again so it is discounted.

inventory.title: Software inventory
inventory.subtitle: {{components}} components across {{projects}} projects. With known unresolved vulnerabilities: {{vulnerable}}. Out of date: {{outdated}}.
inventory.capped: The list stopped at the panel's component cap; the remaining projects were not counted.

vulndb.none: Vulnerability database: no local copy yet
vulndb.disabledNone: Vulnerability database: no local copy and synchronisation disabled
vulndb.bodySync: OSV + NVD (CVE.org), synchronised every {{hours}} hours. If this deployment has no internet access, the file is imported by hand — an external service is never queried live.
vulndb.bodyImportOnly: OSV + NVD (CVE.org). This deployment does not synchronise: the database is imported by hand from a file downloaded elsewhere — an external service is never queried live.
vulndb.reasonHint: Recorded in the audit log under your name. The system performs the download or the file read in the background; this screen only schedules it.
vulndb.fileHint: Accepted: an OSV ecosystem all.zip, or an NVD nvdcve-2.0-<year>.json or .json.gz.
vulndb.reasonLabel: Why you are updating the database

inventory.syncQueued: Synchronisation enqueued. The copy's date will change when it finishes.
inventory.importQueued: Import enqueued. The copy's date will change when it finishes.

open.title: With open vulnerabilities
open.meta: Critical: {{critical}} · high: {{high}} · medium: {{medium}} · low: {{low}} · marked "not affected" with a justification: {{notAffected}}

outdated.title: Out of date
outdated.meta: Against the newest version known to the local copy: a fixed version in an advisory, or the one another factory project uses.

byProject.title: By project
byProject.desc: Every analysis keeps its own inventory, so the trend between versions is visible.
byProject.none: No analysis has produced an SBOM yet.

trend.same: no change since the previous analysis
trend.fewer_one: against the previous analysis: 1 fewer CVE
trend.fewer_other: against the previous analysis: {{count}} fewer CVEs
trend.more_one: against the previous analysis: 1 new CVE
trend.more_other: against the previous analysis: {{count}} new CVEs

open.title: Components with open vulnerabilities
open.none: No component has a known vulnerability in the local copy.
open.hint: "Not affected" is the analyst's decision with a written justification; it is recorded in the audit log and in the VEX document exported with the SBOM.
open.uncomparable_one: 1 component has a version that cannot be compared (a range or a link, for example) and was not correlated.
open.uncomparable_other: {{count}} components have a version that cannot be compared (a range or a link, for example) and were not correlated.

crypto.title: Cryptography detected (CBOM)
crypto.none: No cryptography was detected in the analysed code.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitleAdmin: Every action in one sentence: who did what and when. With the admin role you see the whole factory.
audit.subtitleOwn: Every action in one sentence: who did what and when. You see your own actions.
audit.none: No actions recorded in this period.

action.authz.denied: attempted an action their role does not allow
action.finding.verdict.false_positive: discarded a finding as a false positive
action.verification.reopen: reopened the design of the functions that failed
action.vulndb.import: loaded the imported file into the vulnerability database
